name: flin-meta-ads-mcp
description: Read-only Meta Ads for M1 and newer Macs. Automatically prepares PyPI updates for the next extension start.

app_id.title: Meta App ID
app_id.description: Public numeric App ID for browser login. Optional when using an access token.

app_secret.title: Meta App Secret
app_secret.description: Required for browser login; stored securely by Claude. Never paste it into chat.

access_token.title: Meta Access Token (optional)
access_token.description: Alternative to browser login. Use a token with ads_read; leave empty for browser login.

ad_account_id.title: Default ad account (optional)
ad_account_id.description: Numeric account ID, optionally prefixed with act_. This selects a default, not an access restriction.

login_config_id.title: Business Login configuration ID (optional)
login_config_id.description: Only needed if your Meta app uses Facebook Login for Business.
